summary: Whirlpool Corporation filed an 8-K announcing a private placement of $750M 2031 Second Lien Notes and $750M 2034 Second Lien Notes. It commenced a cash tender offer for any and all outstanding 1.250% Senior Notes due 2026 and 1.100% Senior Notes due 2027 issued by subsidiary Whirlpool Finance Luxembourg, plus a consent solicitation to amend the 2027 indenture to accelerate satisfaction and discharge. No price, premium, or close date provided. Board recommendation not mentioned; no advisors named. What to watch: tender success, consent threshold, refinancing terms, and market reaction to liability management.
